newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish board temporarily suspends a brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Turkish board temporarily suspends a brokerage.

text.p: Turkey's regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) said it halted activities of brokerage house Ozhan Oral Menkul Degerler until it fulfilled its obligation to place a certain amount of securities at the central depository Takasbank.
The SPK said in its weekly bulletin that Ozhan Oral had failed to deliver securities as collateral against its cash and share liabilities to customers working with one of its agencies.

The SPK also said Oki Yatirim ve Menkul Degerler, another brokerage house whose activities were suspended on December 17, would be allowed to resume trade after it raises its capital to 125 billion lira from 100 billion and places 100 billion lira of it at Takasbank in the form of state securities.
There are currently 100 brokerages licensed to operate on the Istanbul Stock Exchange. Arz Menkul Kiymetler is also currently under suspension.
